info.description: Implemented Developer 2 routes. No credentials are included. See ../README.md and the handoff guide for relational, trust and recovery invariants.

factors.explanation: Individually sub-boundary payments including current once are compared with selected approval boundaries; contribution applies once
Submission count includes current exactly once and must exceed the configured maximum
Complete history contains fewer than the configured minimum observations; zero contribution, other rules continue
An actual INACTIVE-to-ACTIVE transition in the inclusive status window is required
Distinct previous submissions with original qualifying factors are counted once; PREVIOUS_RISK_FLAGS never qualifies itself
Supplier creation time is within the inclusive age window
Same supplier and exact payment amount, different normalized invoice number, within the history window; contribution applies once
